subject: Marketplace entry pathway and SKU eligibility criteria
messages:
From: Alexandra Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudchannelpartners.com>

Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@saasco.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: clarifying SKU/packaging + co-sell checklist

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the briefing yesterday — really appreciate the time. We need to finalize the marketplace entry pathway for CloudChannel Partners so AWS team can confirm co-sell eligibility and listings. Quick list of the asks from the vendor side: 

- Which Redwood SKUs do you recommend we list first on AWS vs Azure vs GCP? Any SKUs that are
  strictly "hosted only" (cannot be private/dedicated listings) we should call out.
- Co-sell eligibility: what pricing/discount thresholds, paperwork (co-sell contract addendum), and
  sales motions trigger AWS co-sell handoff?
- Regional gating: are there SKUs you want restricted to US/EU initially for latency/compliance reasons?
- Packaging guidance: single monolithic offer vs lightweight starter + enterprise tier (and recommended
  SKU codes for marketplace SKU mapping).

We've attached the AWS_COSELL_CHECKLIST.pdf that the channel team will use. Can you confirm your recommended first-wave SKU set and any docs we need to include in the listing (SOC2, data flow diagram, customer support SLA language)? If helpful, I can book a 30m sync next week with the AWS GTM rep.

Cheers,
Alexandra Gomez
Partner Lead, CloudChannel Partners
Alex.Gomez@cloudchannelpartners.com
Attachment: AWS_COSELL_CHECKLIST.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Gomez <alex.gomez@cloudchannelpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: clarifying SKU/packaging + co-sell checklist

Alexandra — thanks for the clear asks. Quick response inline and a proposed first-wave matrix attached (sku_eligibility_matrix.xlsx).

High-level proposal (TL;DR):
- Wave 1 (list on AWS & Azure): Core Hosted API (api-standard), Dedicated reserved pool (dedicated-1), Embedding service (embed-lite). These are our lowest-friction listings and align with co-sell pricing bands.
- Wave 1 (GCP - phased): Start with api-standard and embed-lite; defer dedicated until Q3 due to capacity mapping differences.
- Packaging: go with a 2-offer model: Starter (metered, lower price, limited throughput) + Enterprise (committed units, priority support). Map SKU codes in the attached sheet.
- Regional gating: api-standard and embed-lite: global; dedicated-1: US+EU only for now (data residency + capacity).
- Docs required: SOC 2 Type II, Data Flow Diagram (redacted), Support SLA one-pager, and a short runbook for co-sell handoffs.

On co-sell eligibility: we recommend the Partner to present ARR/commitment thresholds or a signed MSA + minimum discount level (we typically put co-sell eligibility at >=20% list discount + signed co-sell addendum). We also require the listing to include a clear trial or Free Tier to help conversions. The attached matrix maps each SKU to an "AWS co-sell readiness" flag.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You review the attached sku_eligibility_matrix and mark any CloudChannel-specific constraints.
2) Schedule a 30-minute alignment with the AWS GTM rep and include our channel lead (Ben).
3) CloudChannel returns the vendor paperwork and we attach SOC2 + runbook to the marketplace listing.

I'll be at hand to present this at the GTM call.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: sku_eligibility_matrix.xlsx

Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: clarifying SKU/packaging + co-sell checklist

Adding a few operational constraints from pricing/offer perspective — short bullets so Ben can include in the ops playbook: 

- Starter offer must cap RPS and have soft limits (to avoid runaway metered costs).
- Enterprise SKU needs a reserved unit definition (monthly commit) and a documented overage rate.
- For AWS co-sell, attach a one-page "deployment architecture" doc for Dedicated SKUs; AWS requests this during initial vet.
- On region gating: EU for Dedicated requires KMS key residency and a regional support SLA.

Ben — can you take point on the GTM call and confirm we can meet the 20% discount floor (or recommend an alternative trigger)? If not, we want to be explicit so CloudChannel can set expectations.

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
